title: From SGD to Muon: Adaptive Optimization via Schatten-p Norms
abstract: arXiv:2605.19781v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern optimizers, like Muon, impose matrix-wise geometry constraints on their updates. These matrix-wise constraints can be unified under Linear Minimization Oracle (LMO) theory. However, all current methods impose fixed LMO geometries for the update rules, chosen by-design or empirically, which are not necessarily optimal according to the problem's geometry. We introduce a novel efficient datadriven criterion for dynamically choosing proxy-optimal update LMO geometries on individual Deep Neural Network layers. Derived in closed form from gradient and activation statistics using a single-step random feature regression surrogate model, our criterion navigates a design space interpolating from SGD to Muon updates. Moreover, integrating parameter-wise preconditioning allows our framework to recover SGD, Muon, Adam, and MuAdam as specific extrema. translated_title: 从SGD到Muon：基于Schatten-p范数的自适应优化
translated_abstract: 现代优化器（如Muon）对其更新施加矩阵级别的几何约束，这些约束可以在线性最小化预言机（LMO）理论下得到统一。然而，现有所有方法都为更新规则施加固定的LMO几何结构，这些结构是通过设计或经验选择的，未必与问题本身的几何特性相符从而并非最优。我们提出了一种新颖且高效的数据驱动准则，用于在深度神经网络的各个层上动态选择近似最优的更新LMO几何结构。该准则借助单步随机特征回归代理模型，从梯度和激活统计量中以闭式形式推导得出，能够在一个从SGD更新到Muon更新之间进行插值的设计空间中自由导航。此外，通过整合参数级预条件化，我们的框架可以将SGD、Muon、Adam和MuAdam作为特定极值情形加以恢复。为使这种自适应方法具备可扩展性，我们将其与高效的计算策略相结合。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于Schatten-p范数的数据驱动准则，可动态地为神经网络各层自适应选择从SGD到Muon之间的最优更新几何结构，并在统一框架下恢复了SGD、Muon、Adam和MuAdam等主流优化器。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a data-driven criterion based on Schatten-p norms that dynamically selects proxy-optimal update LMO geometries (interpolating from SGD to Muon) per neural network layer, unifying SGD, Muon, Adam, and MuAdam within a single adaptive optimization framework.
